Set how often widget data updates automatically

1. Long-press an empty area of the home screen
2. Select "Add widget"
3. Find "OpenWrt Manager"
4. Choose the widget to add
5. Drag it to the desired position
• Widgets need the app running in the background to update data\n• Shorter update intervals drain more battery\n• A 30 or 60 minute interval is recommended

LuCI Simplified Chinese language pack - base package
Package manager - manage all packages on the router, with support for install, remove, and update operations
Firewall configuration - manage port forwarding, traffic rules, zones, and other firewall features
Dynamic DNS configuration - supports multiple DDNS providers and updates domain records automatically
UPnP configuration - Universal Plug and Play, lets devices on the LAN set up port mappings automatically
Wake-on-LAN - send magic packets over the network to wake up computers on the LAN
Smart Queue Management - SQM QoS traffic control that optimizes network latency and bandwidth allocation
Traffic statistics - collects and displays network traffic, CPU, memory, and other system statistics
Aria2 download manager - multi-threaded download tool supporting HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent
Transmission BT client - lightweight BitTorrent download client
Samba4 network sharing - file and printer sharing service, compatible with Windows Network Neighborhood
MiniDLNA media server - DLNA/UPnP media server that lets TVs and phones play videos and music stored on the router
OpenVPN configuration - open-source VPN solution with server and client modes
WireGuard VPN - a modern, fast, and secure VPN tunnel technology
Multi-WAN load balancing - load balancing and failover across multiple broadband lines
SNMP service - Simple Network Management Protocol, used in network monitoring systems
Network bandwidth monitoring - tracks bandwidth usage per device, viewable by day or month
NTP time sync - Network Time Protocol client that syncs the system time automatically
uHTTPd web server - configuration for the lightweight web server built into OpenWrt
Access control lists - manage LuCI user permissions and access control
Ad filtering - automatically blocks ad domains and supports multiple ad source lists
Web terminal - use a command-line terminal in the browser
Disk hibernation - automatically puts idle disks into sleep mode to save power
FTP server - lightweight FTP server with virtual users and permission control
UDPXY multicast to unicast - converts IPTV multicast streams to unicast for easy viewing on any device
Frp server - tunnel server that makes LAN services accessible from the internet
Frp client - connects to an Frp server to tunnel LAN services to the internet
ZeroTier virtual network - a global virtual LAN for easily building virtual networks across locations
